title: A Kansas goldenrod
done: You made goldenrod! Bees and bugs carry its pollen, not the wind, so it does not make people sneeze.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table. It is the stem.
Put another green square on top. The stem grows.
Put a yellow square on top of the stem. Goldenrod flowers are yellow!
Put a yellow square on the left.
Put a yellow square on the right.
Put a yellow triangle on top, at the left.
Put a yellow triangle on top, at the right.
Put a tall yellow triangle in the middle. It makes a fluffy top!
